description: This file defines an interface `AuthenticationProvider` responsible for authenticating requests within a gateway security context. It specifies methods for checking applicability of the provider and for performing authentication asynchronously, returning a result of a generic type.

classes.name: AuthenticationProvider
classes.description: A generic interface for providing authentication mechanisms for requests, with methods to determine applicability and to authenticate asynchronously.

methods.name: isApplicable
methods.description: Determines whether this authentication provider can handle the given request context.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Performs the authentication of a request context asynchronously, returning a future holding the result.
